summary: validateApp now throws if owner missing/empty (shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0, breaking). Billing passes 'payments', reports 'insights' (from package.json team). Also updated core-shell (owner 'platform' from its package.json team) since it calls validateApp and would otherwise fail at startup. Assumptions: lib lives in the monorepo and is inlined at build, so one PR covers all sub-tasks; hardcoded owner strings match package.json team. All three apps build; CI and CD green.
